## Functions

### `makeGpuShim({ metrics, onError, gpuHost = null, appId = '' } = {})`

Create a per-realm navigator.gpu shim with an explicit ownership policy. In WebGPU OS, `gpuHost.policy === 'shared-kernel'` returns broker facades and never calls the ambient navigator.gpu acquisition path. Standalone compat runtimes use a dedicated-owned device and destroy it during realm teardown.

### `disposeGpuShim(shim)`

### `installGpuCanvasBridge({ realm, gpuHost, appId, onError } = {})`

Patch only canvases owned by one compatibility realm. The returned document proxy also patches synchronously-created canvases before guest code can call getContext('webgpu').
